title: baccharis macrantha subsp. cocuyensis
intro: Baccharis macrantha subsp. cocuyensis, commonly known as "Cocuyensis", is a subspecies of shrub in the Asteraceae family, native to the Andean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis macrantha subsp. cocuyensis include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it effective in treating wounds, infections, and various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
